title.en: Control of Vectors and Pesticides (Specified Mosquito Control Work — Exemption) Regulations 2026

completenessNote: 全文，共 7 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Control of Vectors and Pesticides (Specified Mosquito Control Work — Exemption) Regulations 2026 and come into operation on 1 April 2026.

heading.en: Persons exempt from registration as vector control operators

text.en:
3.—(1) Section 24(a) of the Act does not apply to a person (A) in relation to any specified mosquito control work that A undertakes or engages in in the course of any trade or business.
(2) Section 24(b) of the Act does not apply to a person (B) in relation to any advertisement by B or holding out by B that B is a person who, in the course of any trade or business, undertakes or engages in specified mosquito control work.

heading.en: Persons exempt from licensing as vector control technicians

text.en: 4. Section 25 of the Act does not apply to a person (C) insofar as C acts as or carries out the work of a specified mosquito control technician.

heading.en: Persons exempt from certification as vector control workers

text.en: 5. Section 26 of the Act does not apply to a person (D) insofar as D acts as or carries out the work of a specified mosquito control worker.

heading.en: Exemption for registered vector control operators in relation to specified mosquito control work

text.en: 6. Section 27 of the Act does not apply to a registered vector control operator (E) in relation to any employment or engagement by E of any person to carry out the work of a specified mosquito control technician or specified mosquito control worker.

heading.en: Exemption for vector control technicians in relation to specified mosquito control work

text.en: 7. Section 28 of the Act does not apply to a vector control technician (F) insofar as F allows any person to assist him or her, or to partake, in the carrying out of any specified mosquito control work.
